routes.title: Separate organics for composting or biomethanation
routes.advice: Keep food and garden waste separate from dry recyclables. Uttar Pradesh policy identifies composting and biomethanation as preferred organic-waste pathways. No active Lucknow intake site is verified in this directory; confirm collection with Lucknow Nagar Nigam before handing waste over.

routes.title: Keep dry recyclables clean and ask for an authorized local handoff
routes.advice: Separate clean paper, metal, glass and accepted plastics. State policy describes material-recovery centres and authorized waste pickers or recyclers; this directory does not verify a named Lucknow recycler or its current intake. Confirm the ward-level handoff with Lucknow Nagar Nigam.

routes.title: Use a producer take-back or CPCB-registered e-waste channel
routes.advice: Do not place electronics in mixed household waste or dismantle them. Use the producer's take-back instructions or check CPCB's e-waste portal for registered entities. The portal is an authorization and registration resource, not a verified Lucknow household collection booking; local collection availability is unverified.

routes.title: Keep domestic hazardous waste separate and request municipal directions
routes.advice: Keep batteries, blades, chemicals and other household hazardous items separate, sealed where safe, and away from children. Uttar Pradesh policy requires separate handling; no household hazardous collection point is verified here. Ask Lucknow Nagar Nigam for current safe handoff instructions.

routes.title: Request municipal segregation and collection guidance
routes.advice: Do not burn the pile or move hazardous contents by hand. The material is mixed or uncertain, so ask Lucknow Nagar Nigam to confirm the appropriate collection route. No site-specific pickup has been booked by WasteLens.

energy_pathway_note.title: RDF and waste-to-energy are not configured as local destinations
energy_pathway_note.advice: Uttar Pradesh policy describes RDF and waste-to-energy pathways for suitable residual waste. WasteLens has not verified a currently operating Lucknow intake facility or its acceptance rules, so it will not direct a report there.
